title: Gabber regular pairs cover the prime-to-ell alteration site
statement: Let $S$ be a reduced Noetherian scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], where Noetherian means admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings. Suppose that every affine coordinate ring of $S$ is quasi-excellent [def-exc-excellent-ring]. Let $Z$ be a nowhere dense closed subset of $S$, and let $\ell$ be a prime invertible on $S$. There are finitely many regular Noetherian schemes $T_b$ [def-weil-regular-scheme] and morphisms $q_b:T_b\to S$ which are objects of $\operatorname{alt}/S$ and form a covering for the topology of $\ell'$-alterations [def-per-prime-to-ell-alteration-topology]. In particular every $q_b$ is of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For each $b$ there is a strict normal crossings boundary $H_b\subseteq T_b$ [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary] whose support is $q_b^{-1}(Z)$.

source.place: Expose IX, Theorem 1.1, printed p. 131; the alteration category and topology are those of Expose II 1.2.2 and 2.3.1. Boundary is taken with reduced structure, as in VIII 4.1.4 and 4.2.2(i).
